name: Lucifer
overview: The term 'Lucifer' appears in Isaiah 14:12, describing a fallen figure called the 'son of the morning' who has been cast down from heaven after weakening nations. This passage, along with Ezekiel 28:14-17, portrays a being once perfect and exalted on God's holy mountain, an anointed cherub whose pride and corruption led to his downfall. Ezekiel emphasizes the loss of perfection due to iniquity and the judgment that follows, highlighting the spiritual rebellion behind this fall. Luke 10:18 echoes this theme by depicting Satan's fall from heaven like lightning, connecting Lucifer to the ultimate adversary defeated by Christ.
